description: Power BI User Feedback Pro Power BI User Feedback Pro is a powerful custom visual designed to help organizations securely gather actionable insights directly from their dashboard users. This tool enables creators to understand user needs, improve dashboard usability, and deliver greater value, all while ensuring that all data remains securely within the enterprise. Who Benefits from This Offer This tool is ideal for: Power BI Dashboard Creators: Gain valuable insights to refine dashboard design and usability. Data Analysts: Collect feedback to drive data-driven improvements and optimize reporting. Business Intelligence Professionals: Enhance user engagement and reporting effectiveness. IT Administrators: Manage feedback data securely within enterprise environments. Customer Needs Addressed Understanding how dashboards perform in real-world usage is critical to ensuring their effectiveness. Power BI User Feedback Pro addresses this by: Providing a seamless way to collect ratings and feedback directly within Power BI reports. Ensuring secure data handling, with all feedback stored and analyzed through Azure Application Insights, keeping data within the organization’s trusted environment.
